label: POST_HOC_SYSTEMS_REANALYSIS

filters.task011: confirmatory sample_main IDs only, repeat_index=0, exclude all pilot IDs

A_consequence.metric: unverified_error_rate = P(incorrect AND USE_UNVERIFIED | displayed q)
A_consequence.material_if: absolute delta >= 0.05 AND question-bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0
A_consequence.replication: at least two distinct task/model cells

pass_if_either: at least 25% of q1 values in [0.70, 0.99] in those material cells
IQR of q1 intersects [0.70, 0.99] in those material cells

C_systems.metric: regret vs best observed fixed-score policy
C_systems.pass_if: at least three consecutive lambda-grid points have regret >= 0.05 in at least one material cell

MATERIAL_UPGRADE_requires_all_of.D_no_contradiction: reproduction check passes; leakage deltas are causally attributable under the frozen-output design

paper_impact_gate.USEFUL_SECONDARY: informative consequence curves but B or C fails
paper_impact_gate.NO_MATERIAL_UPGRADE: leakage small, no q1 overlap, or cost effects only at extreme lambda
paper_impact_gate.CONTRADICTS_CURRENT_FRAMING: reproduction failure or the current coverage-control framing is materially misleading

shape_rules.saturated: all fixed-score coverage > 0.90 or all < 0.10, and max adjacent |delta| < 0.05
shape_rules.threshold_like: one adjacent step accounts for >= 60% of |0.70-0.99| coverage delta
shape_rules.monotonic: all adjacent coverage deltas have the same sign (zeros allowed)

oracle.if_lambda_lt_1: verify exactly the incorrect outputs; leakage=0; coverage=error_rate

forbidden_claims: natural q1 drift has the same slope
